In Americano, players compete in random teams with the goal of accumulating as many points as possible, with each ball won being a point. All players are initially placed in randomly selected teams, after which the teams are determined by each player's performance. Each ball won gives one point to the winning team. How to play Mixicano?
Mixicano is played just like Americano, although each team must consist of a woman and a man.
